Hi Kimberly — thanks for the detailed note and attachments. Quick responses below: 

1) SKU mapping: For metered/billing we recommend a two-SKU pattern: one SKU for compute (per-inference-minute) and one SKU for ancillary storage. This aligns best with our billing pipeline and makes it easier for customers to consume via the Marketplace UI. I annotated your workbook (see column "GCP_Suggested_SKU") with suggested SKU granularity.

2) Procurement checklist: Helio will need invoice entity name, billing address, PO flow, and a Billing Contact + Technical PO contact. I attached a template PO checklist and copied Samir so he can confirm Helio's internal steps.

3) Co-sell roster: I'll introduce you to Priya Rao (GCP Partner Sales) and Mark Xu (Marketplace PM). Priya typically owns the outreach for partners in your segment.

Next steps I propose:
- Marcus to confirm the suggested SKU names/units so we can provision test SKUs in the Partner Portal (aim: provision by 6/14).
- Helio (Samir) to confirm billing entity and PO cadence by 6/11.
- I will open a Partner Intake ticket and add Priya/Mark for co-sell coordination.

I'll send the Partner Intake ticket ID in a follow-up.
